Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production RGBA sprite atlas for an isometric iOS RTS, four columns by two rows, landscape 2:1 canvas.
Reference image: the supplied original desert gunship; preserve its recognizable silhouette, olive/sand camouflage, tandem teal canopy, mast radar, stub wings and rocket pods. Create a NEW eight-direction atlas of this same original vehicle.
Primary request: eight distinct high quality miniature 3D gunship renders viewed from the SAME fixed elevated camera about 45 degrees down. Rotate the actual aircraft in 45 degree steps. Consistent realistic physical scale, crisp restrained edge highlights, detailed panels/rotor hub/weapons, matte desaturated materials.
Composition: mathematical 4x2 equal SQUARE cells, every aircraft centered in its own cell. Top row left to right: E (nose RIGHT), NE (nose UPPER RIGHT, see rear), N (nose UP, see rear), NW (nose UPPER LEFT, see rear). Bottom row: W (nose LEFT), SW (nose LOWER LEFT, see cockpit), S (nose DOWN, see cockpit), SE (nose LOWER RIGHT, see cockpit).
All eight include the complete main rotor and tail rotor without clipping. All parts fit inside the CENTRAL 68 percent of each cell. Broad completely empty transparent gutters between all cells. Same fixed rotor blade phase and same elevation in all views. Four crisp dark blades, no huge motion disk, no cast ground shadows, no rotor wash, no smoke. Real transparent background, alpha zero for all empty pixels. No opaque backdrop, text, grid, letters, UI, flags, emblems, bloom, colored halos or detached fragments. This is a game-ready atlas, not a poster or concept sheet. Do not repeat a view or simply mirror a different aircraft.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production eight-direction sprite atlas for an original isometric military RTS; truly transparent RGBA.
Reference image: preserve this ONE exact silver-gray twin-engine fighter with twin vertical tails, swept wings, dark canopy, restrained cyan optics/wing accents and four white underwing missiles. Same plane in all eight views, no redesign.
Primary request: exactly eight full detailed renders in a regular FOUR columns by TWO rows equal-cell landscape atlas. Fixed orthographic camera 35 degrees above horizontal, plane flying level. Rotate the physical aircraft in 45-degree yaw increments, never rotate a flat image. Same physical scale, lighting, airframe and loadout in every cell.
Row 1, left to right: (1) nose points RIGHT, side/top view. (2) nose points UPPER RIGHT AWAY from viewer, rear-right quarter view; jet exhausts/tail are closest to viewer and nose is far away. Do NOT repeat the lower-right frontal view. (3) nose points UP AWAY, directly rear/top view, twin exhausts closest to viewer. (4) nose points UPPER LEFT AWAY, rear-left quarter view.
Row 2: (5) nose points LEFT, side/top view. (6) nose points LOWER LEFT TOWARD viewer, front-left quarter view; canopy and nose closest. (7) nose points DOWN TOWARD viewer, straight front/top view. (8) nose points LOWER RIGHT TOWARD viewer, front-right quarter view matching reference.
Premium miniature 3D painted game art, crisp readable silhouette and metal panel detail, subtle sun from upper-left, no neon bloom. Each full aircraft centered on the same center pivot within its cell; equal generous transparent gutters. No cropping of wings, missiles or tails. No cast ground shadow or landing gear.
Critical transparency constraint: every pixel outside the airplane silhouettes must have alpha ZERO, genuine transparent background. Do not produce a white, gray, translucent paper, checkerboard or sky backdrop. No trails, exhaust fire, scenery, text, numbers, labels, grid lines, UI, watermarks or extra vehicles. Only eight views of ONE identical original aircraft.
